Din Bhar Hussain Apne Lahoo Mai Nahaye Hain Syed Mudassir Mehdi
Kya Kya Jawan Beton Ke Lashay Uthaye Hain.

1
Itna Tu Aab Bhi Na Tha Nehar-e-Furat Mein.
Jitnay Ali Ki Beti Ne Aanso Bahaye Hain.
Kulsoom Noha Parhti Hain Roti Hain Bibiyaan.
Shabeer Ba Wafa Ka Alam Le Ke Aaye Hain.

2
Khak-e-Shifa Mein Khon Mila Har Shaheed Ka.
Qasim Ne Apne Jism Ke Tukray Malaye Hain.
Maqtal Mein Maa Ne Bhaija Hai Kis Ahtamam Se.
Kurta Pisar Ka Badla Hai Gesu Banaye Hain.

3
Peshani-e-Hussain Ka Asghar Ka Mashk Ka.
Zainab Ko Teen Teer Nahi Bhool Paye Hain.
Kata Tha Jis Sakon Se Zalim Ne Sheh Ka Sar.
 Akbar Ossi Sakon Se Khaimay Jalaye Hain.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/din-bhar-hussain-apne-lahoo-mai-tajpoints-7768511b736fb702b317.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = [[line.strip() for line in block.splitlines()] for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [2, 5, 5, 5]
    assert [block[0] for block in blocks[1:]] == list(numbers)
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified 14 verses in each edition, with a two-verse opening and three four-verse stanzas.')
PY

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman verse wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have a two-verse opening and three four-verse stanzas. Updated the title and right-to-left direction, and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag.

I treated “Syed Mudassir Mehdi” after the opening verse as an appended credit and omitted it from both editions.
